prompt.en: What reason did the man give God for hiding when called?

text.en: He feared being sent away from the garden
He felt exposed and afraid before God
He expected the serpent to confront him again
He wanted to find the woman before answering

explanation.en: When questioned, the man connected his fear to being naked and said that he hid.

prompt.en: What visible sign did God appoint to recall the covenant concerning the earth and its creatures?

text.en: A colored arc across the sky
The floodwater receding from the land
A dove returning with an olive leaf
An altar built after leaving the ark

explanation.en: God identifies the rainbow in the cloud as the sign of the covenant with Noah, his descendants, and every living creature.

prompt.en: What two concerns motivated the builders to make a city and a tower?

text.en: To defend their settlement from rival peoples
To preserve their speech and shared customs
To gain renown and stay together
To secure land for crops and livestock

explanation.en: The builders say they wanted to make a name for themselves and prevent their scattering across the earth.

prompt.en: What immediate outcome did God send Moses to seek from Pharaoh?

text.en: A reduction in Israel's work quotas
Longer rest periods for enslaved households
A move to another district within Egypt
Israel's release from Egypt

explanation.en: God says he has seen Israel's oppression and sends Moses to bring the people out of Egypt.

prompt.en: When Israel feared the approaching Egyptians, what did Moses tell the people to do?

text.en: Retreat toward Egypt to avoid the sea
Form a line and fight the chariots
Do not fear; see God's deliverance
Scatter along the shore and hide

explanation.en: Moses tells them not to fear and to witness Yahweh's salvation; he says Yahweh will fight for them.

prompt.en: While bringing a gift to the altar, someone remembers that their brother has something against them. What should they do first?

text.en: Finish the offering, then speak later
Pause the offering and seek reconciliation
Ask the priest to settle it first
Wait until the brother apologizes

explanation.en: Jesus says to leave the gift, first be reconciled with the brother, and then come back to offer it.

prompt.en: Why does Jesus say his disciples need not use many words when praying?

text.en: Their Father already understands their needs
Many words earn greater public honor
Repeated requests make prayer more acceptable
Requests are heard only when spoken aloud

explanation.en: Jesus says the Father knows what people need before they ask, so they should not imitate those who expect many words to make them heard.

prompt.en: What did Jesus tell John's messengers to report as evidence in response to John's question?

text.en: That he had gathered a political army
That he had taken the throne in Jerusalem
That the temple leaders had endorsed him
The healings and good news they witnessed

explanation.en: Jesus directs them to report the works they hear and see: healing, raising the dead, and good news preached to the poor.

prompt.en: What did the narrator explain Jesus meant by raising the temple in three days?

text.en: Rebuilding the courts after the merchants left
Restoring the temple after forty-six years
Raising his body after death
Reopening the temple at Passover

explanation.en: The narrator clarifies that Jesus was speaking about the temple of his body; the disciples understood after he was raised.

prompt.en: After the crowd had eaten, what did Jesus instruct the disciples to do with the remaining food?

text.en: Let the disciples eat it before leaving
Save the surplus rather than discard it
Leave it on the hillside for others
Have the crowd carry it away

explanation.en: Jesus tells the disciples to gather the remaining pieces; they collect twelve baskets from the five barley loaves.
